analysis.executive_summary: Documentation audit of polar.sh/docs covered 277 pages (100% crawl coverage) with 91.5% overall confidence. Critical gaps identified: 4 confirmed broken internal links, 18.32% SEO/geo issue rate, and only 18.77% of pages display last-updated timestamps. API reference coverage at 67.34% across 197 detected API pages indicates incomplete documentation. Example reliability scored 0.0%, signaling absent or non-functional code samples.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage achieved (100% of 277 pages in scope)
High overall audit confidence at 91.5% with strong link verification (95%)
Single-product topology provides clear documentation structure
197 API pages detected and analyzed for reference completeness
risks: 4 confirmed broken internal documentation links damage user navigation and trust
18.32% SEO/geo issue rate severely impacts discoverability and search ranking
32.66% API reference gap leaves significant functionality undocumented
0.0% example reliability indicates code samples are missing, broken, or undetectable
81.23% of pages lack last-updated dates, obscuring content freshness and accuracy
API confidence at 85% suggests potential undetected API pages or classification errors
Missing freshness metadata undermines user confidence in documentation currency

prioritized_actions.action: Fix all 4 broken internal documentation links immediately
Implement last-updated timestamps on all 225+ pages currently missing them
Audit and remediate 18.32% SEO/geo issues (meta descriptions, titles, structured data)
Document missing 32.66% of API reference content across 197 API pages
Add functional, tested code examples to address 0.0% reliability score

limitations: External audit cannot verify accuracy of technical content, only structural completeness and link validity
Example reliability at 0.0% may indicate detection limitations if examples exist but use non-standard formatting
API coverage assessment depends on page classification heuristics; 85% confidence suggests possible false negatives
Crawl limited to 277 of potential 1500 max pages; undiscovered content outside sitemap scope not evaluated
SEO/geo issue severity and business impact require manual review; automated detection flags potential problems only
